zh: 闪卡正面现在也跟手了：还没有翻开的卡，往任何方向果断一甩就会跳过，小幅拖动会弹回来——正面只有单词，拖动时不显示评分颜色。同时修掉了一个确定性闪退：在没有任何朗读音色的手机上，连续翻卡会触发朗读引擎的重建循环，第二次翻面必然栈溢出崩溃；现在引擎初始化失败时不再回放排队的朗读请求。
en: The front of a flashcard now follows the hand too: a decisive throw in any direction skips the unseen card, and a short drag springs back — the front shows only the word, without any grading tint. This release also fixes a deterministic crash: on phones with no speech voices, consecutive flips sent the TTS engine into a rebuild loop and the second flip died with a stack overflow; a failed engine init no longer replays the queued speech requests.
